messages:
jamal: T-minus 30m for the mobile-v3 launch quiet window. Quick checklist — keep replies short: pin release, lock flags, canary capacity, rollback thresholds, release notes posted? owners tagged.

maya: on it. release notes live: https://intra.redwood/release/mobile-v3/notes :memo:

alex: pinning release now. tag created `release/v3.7.1-20260320` and pushed. image built: `gcr.io/redwood/mobile:v3.7.1`.

deploy-bot: Canary create request received. Canary started at 4012345565 — 1% traffic routed to 10 pods in us-west-2.

sre-oncall: Observability checks in place. Dashboards: mobile-v3-smoke, api-latency, error-rate. Alert thresholds set: error_rate > 2% for 5m OR p95 +200ms.

jamal: DB migration? feature flag flips?

alex: No DB migration. Feature flags locked for rollout. We'll use staged feature flag for region parity.

maya: Smoke end-to-end tests passed on canary (auth, search, compose). A/B metric delta within expected noise.

ops-sre: KMS/HSM access validated for the private deploy; no secrets errors in canary logs.

alex: Rollback plan: immediate revert to previous stable tag if alerts hit. Command ready:
`./deploy rollback --env prod --from release/v3.7.1-20260320 --to release/v3.6.9`
Also fallback: switch routing to quantized variant `v3.7.1-quant` if latency regresses.

sre-oncall: Adding manual guard: if error_rate > 1.5% for 3m during ramp — pause and notify SRE/runbook.

jamal: Ramp plan: 1% -> 10% (15m) -> 50% (30m) -> 100%. If no critical alerts, start first ramp at +15m. owners: @maya final product ok, @alex deploy, @sre-oncall monitors.

deploy-bot: Ramp to 10% initiated at 4012345590.

maya: :thumbsup: watching metrics. call me if anything spikes > expected.

alex: Logging: `kubectl -n prod logs -lapp=mobile -f --since=10m` for quick tail.

jamal: final check — are release notes in the changelog and customer-facing doc synced?

maya: synced. sent to #announcements scheduled at T+40m.

ops-sre: backing up current routing config and saving snapshot: `route-snapshot prod mobile pre-v3-20260320` done.

jamal: OK — proceeding with ramp schedule. If anyone sees anything immediately call the emergency bridge (link in #incidents). Good luck everyone :rocket:
